statusLine.command: input=$(cat); current_dir=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir'); dir_name=$(basename "$current_dir"); if [ -d "$current_dir/.git" ]; then cd "$current_dir" && branch=$(GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null) && status=$(GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null) && if [ -n "$status" ]; then printf "➜  %s git:(%s) ✗" "$dir_name" "$branch"; else printf "➜  %s git:(%s)" "$dir_name" "$branch"; fi; else printf "➜  %s" "$dir_name"; fi
